steps: Open the home page and observe the hero, plan pitch, and quote CTA.
Navigate to /pet-insurance-plan/ and read the coverage and exclusion detail.
Navigate to /cat-insurance/ from the primary navigation.
Follow the Start Quote CTA into the quote funnel entry.
On the funnel start screen select species Cat.
Enter pet name Willow, ZIP 44301, age 2 Years, gender Female, breed Domestic Shorthair.
Enter the recorded non-deliverable synthetic email address.
Submit See My Rates and land on the plan rates screen with priced plan cards.
From the rates screen adjust deductible, annual limit, and reimbursement rate.
Observe the premium recalculate deterministically from the local rating table.
Toggle the preventive-care add-on and observe the price delta.
Open plan detail to review coverage specifics.
Select the customized plan and continue to the source-evidenced contact checkout screen.
Complete synthetic contact and address details, choose Monthly or Annually, and accept the terms.
Continue to the clearly labeled clone-local payment simulation.
Choose the opaque simulated approval scenario; no card, bank, wallet, token, or provider credential is entered.
Observe the deterministic local policy number and the local policy-confirmation outbox result.
Repeat the same enrollment request and observe the same policy number without a duplicate row.
Reach checkout with the selected pet plan and synthetic contact data.
Observe the server-derived USD amount and the explicit Local simulation label.
Submit only the opaque sandbox-approved scenario ID.
The server creates and consumes the matching approval in the same SQLite transaction that inserts the enrollment and policy-confirmation outbox job.
Repeat the same request and observe the original policy, payment snapshot, and mail job without a duplicate charge or receipt.
Submit the sandbox-declined scenario and observe that no policy or mail job is created.
Submit the sandbox-retry scenario and observe a retryable result with no policy or mail job.
Change the scenario to sandbox-approved without changing the quote snapshot.
Observe exactly one consumed approval, one policy, and one local confirmation job.
On the funnel start screen submit See My Rates with required fields empty.
Observe inline validation errors on pet name, ZIP, breed, and email.
Correct the fields and observe the errors clear.
Enter the captured out-of-market ZIP scenario.
Submit the quote form.
Observe the frozen no-quote or ineligible response without creating a quote.
Create a local quote with the frozen synthetic scenario.
Look it up using the same email and ZIP pair.
Resume the quote with the same pet and pricing state; no mail is sent.
Open /portal/#/login and submit an empty form to observe the captured validation state.
Submit synthetic credentials.
Observe the truthful member-access-unavailable response; no session cookie is created.
Follow the captured register affordance from the portal login shell.
Submit an empty form to observe local validation.
Submit a synthetic identity and observe the truthful member-access-unavailable response; no account or mail job is created.
Follow Forgot your password? from the captured login shell.
Submit an empty form to observe local validation.
Submit a synthetic email and observe the truthful member-access-unavailable response; no reset challenge or mail job is created.
